title: Incudo feature library
description: A user's own features, kept as incudo-features.json in their character library folder (ADR 0106), and given to any character of the feature's system as a copy that records which feature and revision it came from. A feature is a character's custom feature (ADR 0063, 0065, 0094) plus the system whose stats it names and a revision. A user's own file, so a public format.

id.description: Unique in the file; what a character's copy records.

system.description: The system whose stats the lines name, by id. A character is offered its own system's features.

revision.description: Raised by every change; a copy recording a lower one is offered the change.

type.description: The element type it is listed as when given, if the character's kind lists it; else the kind's default.

mode.description: As a character's custom feature line: `add` contributes, `set` is where the stat starts, `mark` marks a row (ADR 0063, 0094).
